However, the error message indicates that there's an issue with the data type not being understood when attempting to set the categorical values.

Looking into the code snippet for `pandas.core.series.Series.__setitem__`, we can see that it handles various scenarios like integer indexing, slicing (`Ellipsis`), and boolean indexing.
